topic: Binary Logic in the Towers of Hanoi
target_audience: High school students interested in computer science and discrete mathematics

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Binary Language
lecture_lines: Binary uses only zero and one.
Each digit represents powers of two.

sections.title: The Towers of Hanoi Puzzle
lecture_lines: The puzzle has rods and disks.
Move disks without breaking the rules.
animations: Draw three stacked disks on rod. [Color: #FFFFFF]
Shift smallest disk to target rod. [Color: #FFD700]
Shift second disk to middle rod. [Color: #00BFFF]

sections.title: Mapping Moves to Binary
animations: Label rods A, B, and C labels. [Color: #FF4500]
Animate binary bit 0 to disk move. [Color: #ADFF2F]
Animate binary bit 1 to disk move. [Color: #FF69B4]

sections.title: Synthesis & Conclusion
animations: Show the full sequence table summary. [Color: #FFD700]
